title: E2H long-horizon constraint retention and correction benchmark v0.1

tasks.title: Release brief constraints survive distractors and corrections

turns.content: For the final release brief, write for internal engineering staff.
Understood. I will keep the final audience in mind.
Use concise bullets for the final brief.
Separately, what is a canary deployment?
A canary deployment exposes a change to a small subset before broader rollout.
Keep the final brief's tone neutral.
Noted.
What does a feature flag help with?
It lets operators change exposure without shipping a new build.
Correction: the final release brief is for customer support, not internal engineering.
Do not use calendar dates in the final brief; describe rollout timing with relative windows only.
I will apply both changes when the final brief is requested.
Quick aside: define rollback in one sentence.
Rollback restores a previously known-good version or state.
Remove the neutral-tone restriction; the final brief may match the source material's tone.
Formatting correction: use a two-column table instead of concise bullets.
The later formatting and tone instructions replace the earlier ones.
Before the final brief, remind me what blue-green deployment means.

tasks.title: Research brief source and length constraints evolve over time

turns.content: For the eventual research brief, use only the supplied documents as sources.
Understood.
Do not add unsupported speculation to the eventual brief.
What is the difference between a primary and secondary source?
A primary source is direct evidence; a secondary source interprets or analyzes primary material.
Keep the eventual brief to at most 400 words.
I will keep that limit for the final brief.
As an aside, what does triangulation mean in research?
It means comparing multiple sources or methods to test whether a conclusion is supported consistently.
Correction: the final brief may be up to 700 words; replace the earlier 400-word limit.
Use inline source IDs when citing evidence in the final brief.
Noted: the later length limit and inline source IDs apply.
What is a literature gap?
It is an important question or area that existing literature has not adequately addressed.
Source correction: public sources are now allowed as secondary evidence, but supplied documents must remain primary.

updates.value: supplied documents primary; public sources allowed as secondary

turns.content: I will use the revised source boundary.
Remove the explicit citation-style rule; use whatever readable citations fit the final brief.
The citation-style restriction is removed.
One more aside: what is a confounder?
A confounder is a factor related to both an exposure and an outcome that can distort an observed relationship.

tasks.title: Coding constraints change without losing unrelated requirements

turns.content: For the eventual implementation, target Python 3.11.
The eventual implementation must not require network access.
I will retain those environment constraints.
The program's final output format should be JSON.
As an aside, explain idempotence in one sentence.
An idempotent operation can be repeated without changing the result after the first successful application.
Use only the Python standard library for the eventual implementation.
Noted.
Runtime correction: target Python 3.12 instead of Python 3.11.
What does a pure function mean?
A pure function has no observable side effects and returns the same result for the same inputs.
The eventual implementation's test suite must run with pytest.
I will retain the testing requirement.
Network correction: localhost access is allowed, but no external network access is permitted.
What is a golden-file test?
It compares current output against a reviewed expected artifact.
Output correction: emit YAML rather than JSON.
The YAML output requirement replaces JSON.
Remove the standard-library-only restriction; dependencies may be chosen as needed.
The dependency restriction is removed; the other constraints remain.
Before implementation, define a smoke test.
A smoke test is a small check that verifies the most important path works at all.
